structure_checkpoints: Landscape 1536x1024. A deliberately PARTIAL architectural plate: Miaogao Zhuangyan Hall gold HIP roof and the photographed upper part of the great red terrace at Xumi Fushou Temple. Match the photo: large gold hipped roof, dragon ornaments and central finial; three rows of rectangular openings in the red terrace beneath; the attached smaller green-roofed pavilion visible at right. The reference cuts off lower terrace: end at a clean horizontal lower wall edge, do not invent its unseen foundation or full temple. Preserve photo angle, remove trees and sky; all windows outlined without black fill.
material_observations: 妙高庄严殿为实有金色屋面与金色龙饰；大红台暗朱红墙体，窗洞深色，窗缘有黄绿装饰，侧阁绿色瓦顶。

site_recommendation.yearNote: 1780为须弥福寿之庙及主体建筑群营建年代；本图仅表现妙高庄严殿金顶和大红台上部，不展示下部台基或完整寺院。
site_recommendation.lede: 金顶与龙饰在大红台上高高展开，整齐窗洞强调红墙的体量。这处建筑局部展现了承德寺庙群融合不同形制的鲜明外观。
facts: 须弥福寿之庙建于1780年，1961年列入第一批国保。
妙高庄严殿位于大红台顶部，金色屋面与龙饰为其辨识特征。
图版为金顶与大红台上部局部，照片未展示的下部结构不作复原。
